surfacePatterns.name: animator-lightbox

surfacePatterns.name: outdoor-room-scenes
surfacePatterns.layout: one stage rendering the active outdoor or room scene

surfacePatterns.behavior: stage and SceneEditor filter objects by currentSceneId; bed, desk, chair, and bookcase drag in room; opening and moving through the door enters room; 去室外 returns; currentSceneId, object sceneId, and character scenePositions for outdoor/room persist; missing legacy sceneId defaults to outdoor; four sceneTheme choices affect outdoor only

surfacePatterns.name: companion-activity-state
surfacePatterns.layout: the existing collapsible quick-interaction rail targets the active visible person
surfacePatterns.surface: the same graphite inline-SVG actions and short paper reaction badge
surfacePatterns.behavior: playAction remains the sole action entry; play is outdoor-only; study, work, and rest are room-only; each scene-object person saves its own location and activity; activeActions stay transient; jump wakes a resting person; request tokens prevent an older animation timer from clearing a newer action

surfacePatterns.name: direct-scene-manipulation
surfacePatterns.layout: stage-relative percentage centers with per-object measured bounds
surfacePatterns.behavior: pointer-captured mouse/touch drag; 5px threshold; grab/grabbing; blue-pencil dashed drag frame; moved clicks suppressed

surfacePatterns.name: collapsible-quick-interaction
surfacePatterns.layout: one ordinary-sized open/close control when collapsed; complete action set when expanded
surfacePatterns.surface: compact tracing-paper control and contained action rail
surfacePatterns.behavior: aria-expanded reflects state and expanded copy reminds users they can click characters and objects directly

surfacePatterns.name: draggable-companion-music
surfacePatterns.layout: viewport-clamped floating launcher with a contained music panel
surfacePatterns.surface: small companion paper button above the stage
surfacePatterns.behavior: exact grab offset, 5px threshold, matching pointer capture/release, drag-click suppression, persisted position, and resize/mobile re-clamping; panel links to 位置和大小, 加东西, 装房子, and 显示/隐藏关节 while preserving SceneEditor size controls

surfacePatterns.name: scene-editor-alternative
surfacePatterns.layout: 420px right drawer; mobile bottom sheet capped at 78dvh
surfacePatterns.behavior: labeled horizontal/vertical ranges share the same coordinates and bounds as direct drag for keyboard access

surfacePatterns.name: rig-calibration
surfacePatterns.surface: contained-image paper canvas plus tracing-paper controls
surfacePatterns.behavior: 20px draggable red-pencil nodes with graphite labels; anatomy-aware human, dog, and rabbit templates

surfacePatterns.name: ai-artwork-redraw
surfacePatterns.layout: four equal columns on desktop, two below 1100px, four compact columns below 760px, and two at 430px and below; controls remain at least 52px tall
surfacePatterns.surface: ordinary tracing-paper selection controls beside the calibration canvas
surfacePatterns.behavior: 原图 is permanently retained; Volcengine Ark Seedream image-to-image provides 轻度保留画风, 中度绘本卡通, and 重度角色重绘; pre-action copy discloses the Ark upload and local save; source-and-level results are cached; request identity plus browser abort and server disconnect propagation block obsolete work; generation times out at 180s; controls and confirmation disable while busy; errors restore 原图; PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF input is capped at 6MB and image output at 12MB with MIME validation; ARK_IMAGE_MODEL is independent from vision/chat and defaults to doubao-seedream-4-0-250828

surfacePatterns.name: paper-workspace-layer
surfacePatterns.layout: centered dialogs with 24px inset; scene tools dock directionally
surfacePatterns.behavior: scroll-safe, keyboard focused, one modal plane at a time

surfacePatterns.name: kid-first-tool-language
surfacePatterns.layout: normal-sized plain-text actions in the world header with a contained overflow menu
surfacePatterns.surface: quiet paper pills that preserve stage authority
surfacePatterns.behavior: uses 加东西, 装房子, 移动东西, 放前面, 放后面, and 拿走; never exposes 图层

surfacePatterns.name: companion-growth

surfacePatterns.name: material-library

surfacePatterns.surface: recognizable code-native storybook previews on warm paper cards
surfacePatterns.behavior: new worlds start with background, house, person, and dog only; optional interactive choices add real saved world objects and expose their matching actions; illustrated backgrounds directly replace the stage treatment

surfacePatterns.name: companion-mini-games

components.name: Joint Calibration Workspace
components.description: A rig editor that permanently retains 原图 and offers cached Volcengine Ark Seedream image-to-image redraws: 轻度保留画风, 中度绘本卡通, and 重度角色重绘. Pre-action copy discloses the Ark upload and local save. Request identity, browser abort, server disconnect propagation, a 180s upstream timeout, busy-state disabling, and failure fallback to 原图 keep the flow safe; PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF input is limited to 6MB and validated image output to 12MB. ARK_IMAGE_MODEL is independent from vision/chat and defaults to doubao-seedream-4-0-250828. Native-button nodes preserve the exact grab offset, use the canvas content box, match pointer capture through up or cancel, and stay fully inside measured half-size bounds.

components.name: Joint Inspector Toggle
components.description: An optional diagnostic pill for revealing anatomy-aware nodes over motion artwork.
components.html: <button class="ds-joint-toggle" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 3v6M12 15v6M3 12h6M15 12h6"/></svg>隐藏关节</button>
components.css: .ds-joint-toggle { min-height:44px; padding:0 10px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid rgba(47,50,50,.55); border-radius:6px; color:#fff; background:#c65343; box-shadow:none; font:900 .73rem ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-joint-toggle svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-joint-toggle:hover { filter:contrast(1.08); } .ds-joint-toggle:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd34f; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-joint-toggle:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

narrative.overview:
My Living Drawing is a quiet storybook workbench: warm drafting paper supports a clean pale-sky stage, graphite defines structure, and restrained colored-pencil fills make characters and props feel touched by hand. Construction guides belong only in editing tools; the living world stays free of grids, fold lines, ghost art, and wireframe clouds.

Identity survives from character choice to motion through low-saturation authored sprites and layered hand-drawn CSS scenery. Scene objects are native-button pieces with bounded pointer and touch dragging, grab/grabbing feedback, a blue-pencil dashed drag frame, and a synchronized range-control alternative in the scene editor.
keyCharacteristics: Drafting paper, tracing paper, graphite structure, blue-pencil guides, and low-saturation colored-pencil fills form one unmistakable world.
One framed stage is the interaction anchor; supporting controls stay compact and tactile.
The implemented living world switches between real outdoor and room stages; rendering and SceneEditor stay scoped to currentSceneId.
Each person persists an independent scene location and activity while short action animation stays transient and interruptible.
AI-authored character identities remain recognizable across dedicated motion frames, with genuine RGBA cutouts shared by the stage, materials, and wardrobe.
CSS scenery and hand-drawn props use graphite construction and subdued fill rather than glossy clip art.
All quick actions use one graphite inline-SVG stroke family.
Quick interaction collapses to one ordinary-sized toggle; opening it preserves every action and explains that the stage artwork is directly clickable.
Motion is short, readable, object-specific, and fully reduced when requested.
The living world and its white paper conversation card read as one responsive two-column play surface.
Conversation stays continuous through pale tracing-paper assistant bubbles, muted red-pencil user bubbles, typing dots, quick topics, and one composer.
The world header uses normal-sized, novice-friendly plain-text tools; concise verbs explain the result without oversized or infantilized controls.
A six-category material library and a 120-preset house decoration studio extend the paper world with recognizable code-native storybook previews.
A new world contains only background, house, primary person, and dog; all other interactive scenery remains explicitly addable, while saved projects preserve their creator's additions.
Direct scene manipulation supports mouse, pen, and touch while measured bounds keep complete objects inside the stage.

Joint calibration nodes are direct-manipulation buttons that preserve the exact grab offset, use the rig canvas content box, match pointer capture through completion, and stay fully inside measured half-size bounds.

Before joint placement, the calibration workspace offers 原图 plus three Volcengine Ark Seedream image-to-image redraws—轻度保留画风, 中度绘本卡通, and 重度角色重绘—while permanently retaining 原图 as the non-destructive source.
The scene editor exposes the same coordinates and bounds through labeled range controls for keyboard users.
The room inherits warm paper, graphite structure, and low-saturation colored pencil; bed, desk, chair, and bookcase are draggable scene objects, while the four sceneTheme choices remain outdoor-only.

Door entry switches to room after opening and moving inside, 去室外 returns, and persisted state includes currentSceneId, object sceneId, and separate outdoor/room character scenePositions; legacy objects without sceneId default to outdoor.

The companion music launcher supports exact-offset pointer capture, a 5px drag threshold, viewport clamping, persisted position, and resize/mobile re-clamping; its panel links to 位置和大小, 加东西, 装房子, and joint visibility without removing SceneEditor size controls.
World- and background-drawing steps share one quiet, consistently placed return button; the stage omits translucent drawing-backdrop duplication and wireframe clouds.
Compact mobile treatment begins at `560px` with two-row navigation, `44px` controls, contained horizontal rails, and zero page overflow down to `320px`.

rules.name: The One Red-Pencil Voice Rule
rules.body: Colored-pencil red signals action or deliberate emphasis; never scatter it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Graphite Structure Rule
rules.body: Interactive shapes, authored props, and action icons share graphite definition over layered paper.

rules.name: The Blue Pencil Rule
rules.body: Blue pencil explains construction, position, and movement without competing with action red.

rules.name: The Friendly Weight Rule
rules.body: Use strong weight, compact line length, and scale for hierarchy; do not introduce thin editorial typography.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Tool Rule
rules.body: Header utilities stay at normal control scale and use short concrete verbs. Child-friendly means immediately understandable, not oversized, babyish, or visually loud.

rules.name: The One Stage Rule
rules.body: Each step has one dominant framed task surface; secondary controls orbit it instead of creating competing dashboards.

rules.name: The Layered Paper Rule
rules.body: Use thin graphite borders and warm ambient shadows for sheet order; reserve stronger lift for active dragging.

rules.name: The Exact Joint Grab Rule
rules.body: On `pointerdown`, preserve the exact pointer-to-node-center grab offset and capture that pointer. Resolve movement against the rig canvas padding/content box—not its border box—using `clientWidth` / `clientHeight` and the origin at `rect.left + clientLeft`, `rect.top + clientTop`. Clamp with the measured rendered node half-width and half-height so the complete node remains inside the content box. On matching `pointerup` or `pointercancel`, release capture and clear the drag state; ignore completion from any other pointer. The automated precision check records `0px` displacement at pointer-down, a requested delta of `93px / -47px`, an actual delta of `93.046875px / -47.015625px`, and passing bounds.

dos: Do keep drafting paper, tracing paper, graphite, blue-pencil guides, and subdued colored-pencil fills consistent across every surface.
Do preserve each AI companion's identity across its dedicated motion frames.
Do require genuine RGBA transparency for every character and outfit sheet so stage, material, and wardrobe surfaces never show a paper rectangle.
Do author scene props as simple hand-drawn CSS forms with graphite edges and restrained warm shadows.
Do use the same graphite inline-SVG stroke style for every quick action.
Do collapse quick interaction behind one normal-sized open/close button, preserve all expanded actions, and mention direct stage clicks.
Do keep the joint overlay optional, labeled by anatomy, and visually secondary during motion.
Do keep chat as one continuous transcript with pale tracing-paper assistant bubbles, muted red-pencil user bubbles, visible typing feedback, and action-linked replies.
Do preserve speaker attribution when switching between two companions in one transcript.
Do keep scene dragging bounded, touch-capable, and visible through grab/grabbing, temporary lift, and a blue-pencil dashed frame.
Do render and edit only objects matching currentSceneId, preserve independent outdoor/room character positions, and migrate missing legacy sceneId to outdoor.
Do route enterRoom, leaveRoom, study, work, play, rest, wave, and jump through playAction; enforce scene legality before motion and let only the latest per-person action timer clear itself.
Do keep the room in the Animator's Light Table visual language and scope all four sceneTheme choices to outdoor only.

Do make the music launcher precisely draggable with a 5px threshold, matching pointer capture, viewport clamping, persisted position, and resize/mobile re-clamping; keep the existing SceneEditor size control.
Do use one consistent return control for both world- and background-drawing steps.
Do preserve the exact joint grab offset, use the rig canvas content-box origin and dimensions, clear only the matching captured pointer on up or cancel, and clamp by measured node half-size.
Do disclose before action that AI analysis or redraw uploads the drawing to Volcengine Ark while the work stays saved on this device.
Do keep 原图 permanently available; use Seedream image-to-image for 轻度保留画风, 中度绘本卡通, and 重度角色重绘; cache each source-and-treatment result; and reject stale request identities.

Do abort superseded and unmounted browser requests, propagate client disconnects through the server to Ark, enforce the `180s` upstream timeout, disable treatment selection and final confirmation while processing, and restore 原图 on failure.

Do accept only PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF redraw inputs up to `6MB`, cap generated output at `12MB`, validate downloaded output as `image/*`, and keep `ARK_IMAGE_MODEL` independent from vision/chat with the `doubao-seedream-4-0-250828` default.
Do keep labeled scene-editor ranges synchronized as the keyboard-accessible alternative to direct dragging.
Do keep story tasks progressive and subordinate to the scene they control.
Do reuse the shared graphite scrim and warm-paper shell for export, safety, and rest reminders; use a directional drawer for scene editing.
Do preserve the `1050px`, `820px`, and `560px` responsive behaviors, two-row mobile navigation, `44px` controls, zero horizontal overflow, shared gold focus ring, and reduced-motion override.
Do keep the implemented 390px mobile scene and editor free of horizontal overflow with 44px controls.
Do keep Chinese copy concise, warm, honest about local Demo behavior, and immediately actionable.
Do use normal-sized plain-text header tools and concrete child-facing verbs: `加东西`, `装房子`, `移动东西`, `放前面`, `放后面`, and `拿走`.
Do keep all 60 library items and 120 house presets visually previewable with code-native hand-drawn forms before selection.
Do give every modal initial focus, `Escape` dismissal, contained tab order, and focus restoration to its launcher.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a generic AI upload dashboard or dense control console.
Don't replace a selected character with a generic DOM puppet or unrelated animation asset.
Don't bake white or checkerboard backgrounds into character sheets or use blend modes to imitate transparency.
Don't use emoji as the primary living-world art for sun, tree, apple, house, or dog when authored assets and CSS props exist.
Don't mix icon libraries, filled glyphs, or emoji into the unified quick-action SVG family.
Don't add gradients as ornamental UI styling, glass effects, or low-contrast decoration; the stage's day/night sky transition is functional scenery.
Don't show joint nodes permanently or force animal anatomy into human shoulder-and-hip terminology.
Don't fragment the conversation into a stack of heavy cards or detach it visually and behaviorally from the living world.
Don't reset the transcript when switching companions or duplicate the chat surface.
Don't stack story, editor, export, or safety layers into a competing control dashboard.
Don't compress mobile utility controls below the touch-safe envelope to force one-line navigation.
Don't let any object cross the measured stage boundary or let drag completion fire its click action.
Don't render inactive-scene objects in the stage or SceneEditor, or apply an outdoor sceneTheme to the room.
Don't restore a low-opacity drawing-backdrop from the uploaded character or add wireframe clouds to the clean canvas.
Don't allow quick interaction, the floating music control, its panel, or drawing navigation to create desktop or mobile horizontal overflow.
Don't apply global button press transforms to rig nodes or calculate their drag coordinates from the rig canvas border box.
Don't destructively replace the uploaded original, allow a stale treatment request to win, or leave enhancement and confirmation controls active while processing.
Don't make drag the only positioning method or allow horizontal rails to widen the page.
Don't describe Seedream redraw as a local filter, conceal its Volcengine Ark upload, or imply that the locally saved work makes the AI request device-only.
Don't use “图层” in child-facing UI or substitute oversized, infantilized controls for clear novice-friendly wording.
Don't render material choices as generic chips or house presets as partial color swatches; show the whole object being chosen.
